g.label: Layer 1
g.title: Layer 1
g.text: Pat the Rat went for a stroll. His dad
told him to stay on the path. His dad
also told him not to go into the forest.
Pat did not listen to his dad. He ran into
the forest and got his tail stuck in a trap
in the sand. He could not escape. He sat
down and began to cry. Later, an ant came
by and offered help. Pat did not think a
"My friends can stand on the trap and
tiny ant could help. The any said,
open it." The ant and his friends worked
together and got the trap open. Pat was
free! Pat thanked the ants and ran home.
Pat learned a valuable lesson that day.
